risk_note: RV2 by path (admin login pages and auth provider; the PR carries rule tests). Admin TOTP binding renders the real QR code from the contract otpauth_uri with antd's built-in QRCode (SVG, level M, no new dependency), replacing the F1-06h placeholder; the secret fetch is aborted on every login-generation change and times out after 10 s via setTimeout + abort, late replies dropped; a first /me/permissions failure followed by a successful retry lands on the first permitted menu (or the no-permission page); the top-bar logout is disabled while the request is in flight and re-enabled afterwards. Rule tests by Codex (second call after a timeout-only first call, red first in the container: red/2, 13 tests), spec-test review by a fresh Claude subagent (pass, S2 only, four of them turned into implementation constraints), implementation by Opus 5.5 in one round. Written by hand.

reviews.scope: independent read-only Claude subagent (second reviewer, general): pass, no findings; secret-fetch generation/abort/timeout races, permission retry landing, logout disable/re-enable, QR value source and no secret leakage checked

spec_test_review.note: fresh Claude subagent per tools/agent/README.md §11; six S2 (load-sensitive 5 s timeouts, aria-label binding, logout re-enable, AbortSignal.timeout vs fake timers, 148 frame fit, QR follows new account), four written into the implementation brief as constraints
